Standard deformation theory of invertible sheaves then identifies (id x phi_xi)^*P, for phi_xi the arc with tangent xi in H^1(O_C), with the first-order deformation of O_C classified by xi in Ext^1_C(O_C,O_C)=H^1(O_C); as an underlying O_C-module this is the nonsplit extension 0->O_C->E->O_C->0 of class xi. The competing reading as an O_{C x D}-module extension of class xi tensor eps double-counts the nilpotent and is incorrect. Twisting by omega and using the LES of 0->omega->omega tensor E->omega->0, cup-product with nonzero xi is the Serre pairing H^0(omega)x H^1(O)->H^1(omega), which is surjective, so H^1(omega tensor E) is 1-dimensional; as a D-module for a nonzero arc through e the Fitting-relevant omega-twisted R^1 is length-1 with eps acting by 0, and Fit_0 pulls back to (eps), matching the pullback of I_e. A misreading that effectively kills the connecting map or treats the family as free over D yields the wrong D-module (wrong k-dimension, including attempt-local 3-dimensional bookkeeping failures reported in the adversarial review) and can break the scheme-theoretic test of I_e subset J. Scope: the dual-number module reading is universal for smooth projective curves and the universal Pic Fitting setup of FND-0096 (all g>=1,n>=1); the campaign case (6,6) is the instance used in C66-GEO-Z determinantal scheme-structure proofs.
